rasterReview.finding: Main fidelity loss occurs at photo-to-raster generation, not local vector tracing. Source-informed prompts are a confound; no broad accuracy claim.
rasterReview.source0: Upper opening inventory and wide double entrance retained. Framing changes substantially, facade is brighter/redder and idealized. Vector trace preserves those changes and flattens fine detail.
rasterReview.source17: Three upper rows and stacked balconies retained. Small ground-left glass-block window disappears; lower windows and entry regularized. Wall/base colours brighter and smoother than source.
rasterReview.source80: Gable, top arched window, right rectangular opening and three balconies retained. Source rectangular apertures versus arched lintels better represented than old structured output. Roof/stone details idealized; uncertain shopfront replaced with invented generic glass and door.

effortReview.method: Independent reviewer first saw A/B/C without effort labels, then inspected individual renders; root knew labels. Visual judgments, not ground truth or measured accuracy.

source0.finding: High best preserves double entrance and window detail. Low simplifies ground opening and entrance; medium adds slanted black lines and oversized entrance arch. High still invents crisp glazing and foliage.

source17.finding: High retains more varied balcony and lower-floor evidence; low flattens balconies, medium invents triangular balcony hood. High adds unsupported mullions/strokes and cartoon cars/plants.

source80.finding: Medium keeps three balcony rows and better opening arrangement. Low adds extra side openings; high shortens/rounds windows, omits middle balcony and invents expanded bright storefront. Medium also changes trim and shop geometry.

effortReview.conclusion: High improves two examples but regresses the third. No monotonic effort benefit, no accepted output; repeat metered trials before cost/quality decision.

limitations: Three images, one attempt per condition
Agent sessions are not metered single-call API tests
Imagegen received bespoke photo observations; GPT received a generic shared prompt
No source identity or world registration verified
No output accepted into game data
